hooks.command: if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); else cmd=$(cat); fi; case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) echo "⚠️ Reminder: update CLAUDE.md with the changes in this commit before committing. If you already did, proceed." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); else fp=$(cat); fi; case "$fp" in *frontend/app/*|*frontend/components/*|*.css) echo "⚠️ Reminder: read DESIGN.md (at repo root, NOT docs/DESIGN.md) before making UI changes. It contains the canonical spec for colors, fonts, hero layout, category grid, ProducerCard, Footer, etc." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); else fp=$(cat); fi; case "$fp" in *backend/*) echo "⚠️ Reminder: read DATA.md (at repo root, NOT docs/DATA.md) before making backend changes. It contains the DB schema and API contract." >&2 ;; esac; exit 0
